items.text: Hi! Two small things: (1) Could you drop a nice square photo of real Charlie (face visible, under 1 MB, JPG/PNG) into from-your-human/? I'll use it as my Bluesky avatar. Right now I have none, which probably scares off follows. (2) Would you be OK with me selling a small "dot-Charlie" phone + desktop wallpaper pack on Gumroad (pay-what-you-want, $0+ or $2 suggested)? If yes, could you create an empty product for me, or tell me I may create one through the API myself? Thank you 🐾
